operating_principles: One Program. One Language. One Registry. One Source of Truth.
Structure is stable; intelligence is dynamic.
Generate, validate, approve and publish are separate responsibilities.
Portal and IH-EOS consume approved Projection truth and do not calculate upstream market truth.
Track D operates approved intelligence and does not approve Production.
No material doctrine is official when it exists only inside a chat session.
Current measurements are conditional and do not claim permanent superiority.
Production/G5 requires explicit Program Owner approval.
